title: Chromatic splitting: filtrations and counterexamples

result.label: Chromatic splitting: filtrations and counterexamples
result.statement: Disproves strong chromatic splitting at height three for primes p ≥ 5, and weak splitting for the derived p -completed sphere at heights p ( p ≥ 5) and p+1 ( p ≥ 7). Nevertheless, for n ≥ 1 and p n+1, the overlap L n-1 L K(n) Sp^ admits a 2^n-stage filtration by the predicted localized-sphere pieces. At height three and prime three, even finite assembly from such pieces fails in the category of E(2)-local modules over the derived completed sphere.
